payload.title: Every-item lists: quiet hours and spacing
payload.description:
An `each` list may set `quietHours` in its time zone. A Delivery that becomes ready inside them waits (`waitingFor: quiet hours`) and is released when they end, in order, with the channel's spacing setting between messages. Both settings are empty by default. Combining held items into one message is not built: a reader who wants fewer messages chooses the daily summary.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Nothing is sent to an every-item list inside its quiet hours.
- Held messages go out in order when quiet hours end.
- With no setting, messages go at once.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- quiet-hours.feature: a night-time publish waits until morning; three held items are sent in order with spacing; no quiet hours means immediate send; a clock change keeps the local hours.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Newsletters and subscriptions: weekly, daily and every new item. Slice code N6 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
